277042|6f25fb7c.name: Bezza Shearshave
277042|6f25fb7c.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink $r tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

4262|90df76a3.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|90df76a3.text:
Ah, are you looking perhaps to change your markings, or prepare for a hunt? There is no better place.

You will find the barber in the Tradesman's Terrace, near the auction house.

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2459-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-progress.text: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine.  Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
2459-progress.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2541-progress.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-progress.text: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?
2541-progress.title: The Sleeping Druid

3120-progress.name: Mardant Strongoak
3120-progress.text:
Ah, young $c. I see you're eager to continue your studies. Good.

I wonder, have you spent much time in the Emerald Dream already? Perhaps you're not prepared for that yet... In time, I'm sure.

But until then, we should discuss other matters.
3120-progress.title: Verdant Sigil

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise $c to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-complete.name: Tarindrella
459-complete.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $N.

You confirmed my fears, however.  If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able $C, seek out the knowledgeable $c, Athridas Bearmantle.  He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
459-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

483-progress.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-progress.text:
$N, the kidnapped Druids of the Talon will be forever trapped in the Emerald Dream if we cannot retrieve the Relics of Wakening from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

For every minute we delay their fate comes one step closer to eternal doom.
483-progress.title: The Relics of Wakening

486-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
486-complete.text:
$N, you have proven yourself a most worthy and able $c. A $r who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.

May the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
486-complete.title: Ursal the Mauler

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

5921-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5921-complete.text:
And so it begins, Father Cenarius.  And so it begins.

<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him.  A slight aura of power falls over him.>

The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear.  I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!
5921-complete.title: Moonglade

5929-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5929-complete.text:
<Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach.  Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met.  You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused.  You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work.
5929-complete.title: Great Bear Spirit

6341-progress.name: Vesprystus
6341-progress.text: How may I help you?  Are you in need of transport?
6341-progress.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil

6342-progress.name: Laird
6342-progress.text: Have you come from Teldrassil?  Tell me, how is the fishing there?
6342-progress.title: Flight to Auberdine

6343-progress.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6343-progress.text: $N, you're back from Auberdine?  Did you speak with Laird?
6343-progress.title: Return to Nessa

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

932-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-progress.text: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

937-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-progress.text: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, $N, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
937-progress.title: The Enchanted Glade

96606-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96606-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96630-accept.name: Unknown
96630-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630-accept.title: The Adventurer

96630-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96630-complete.title: The Adventurer

96630-progress.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630-progress.title: The Adventurer

96634-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96634-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96634-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97942-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97942-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97942-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97943-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97943-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97943-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97946-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97946-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97946-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97946-complete.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
97946-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97946-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97949-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97949-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97949-complete.name: Radnaal Maneweaver
97949-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97949-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

97979-accept.name: Shanda
97979-accept.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979-accept.title: The Goddess Provides

97979-complete.name: Shanda
97979-complete.text: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.
97979-complete.title: The Goddess Provides

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98391-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
98391-accept.text:
Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391-accept.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98392-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade

99191-progress.name: Belanaa Windveil
99191-progress.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions.  Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
